Last week the athlete logged 53 miles, well above the 30‑35 mile build target. The hard‑time share rose to 20% and heart‑rate drift climbed, so fatigue and risk of overreaching increased. The easy‑run share is only 56%, below the 80% rule. The athlete asked if they could keep this mileage. The answer is no – we need to drop volume, keep one quality session, and keep most effort easy. This week will be 35 miles: 5 easy runs, 8‑mile quality with 3 mi at marathon pace, and a 12‑mile easy long. Rest days will be true rest.

The knee tightness noted last week may recur, so monitor it after the long. Recovery quality is also a concern; ensure rest days and adequate sleep.

The plan keeps volume low, focuses on threshold work, and stays true to the build phase.
